title: LIVE NOW: META & TESLA REPORT EARNINGS 2026
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets tend to de-risk into major earnings; trimming or holding cash is prudent.
Meta's capex guidance is the key market driver; lower spend guidance would hit neocloud names like NBIS and CoreWeave.
Story stocks run in irrational markets but fundamentals will eventually matter (e.g. Oklo, neoclouds).

calls.reason: Post-earnings gap up of ~4.8% looked like an overbought reversal; he shorted 100 shares (~$71k) as a day trade while staying a long-term holder.
calls.quote: Opening up 25 shares short as Meta gaps up 4.8%... it was a slight little overbought reversal

calls.condition: Wants BTC to actively begin dropping for confirmation; closes shorts before the close.
calls.reason: Intraday overbought reversal after a gap up; fundamentally sees MSTR as a diluting 'Ponzi scheme' that crashes when BTC falls.
calls.quote: This is an overbought reversal. I see it as that. I see some gap down potential.

calls.reason: Car business is fading with low demand and fast depreciation; ~400x P/E unjustified, Optimus and robotaxi still not producing cash flow.
calls.quote: I don't think Tesla will hit their their earnings expectation. I think Tesla it it is now a a fading business

calls.reason: Finds it attractive after the sell-off, but leveraged AI build-out funding OpenAI makes it risky and sentiment/direction remain very weak.
calls.quote: at these prices, I do find it to be attractive. But... market sentiment and market direction for Oracle is just incredibly weak.

notes: Live stream started 12:40 pm Arizona Wed Oct 21 and ran past the 1 pm close into earnings. META/MSTR shorts are day trades; no entry prices given (META resistance 713 broke after earnings). Oklo called overhyped with no trade, SpaceX not a short, IBM/MU only passing - skipped.
